question: Whose invasion of India resulted in the third battle of Panipat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmad Shah Abdali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Third Battle of Panipat** took place on **14 January 1761**, and it was one of the bloodiest battles in human history.
 
• It was fought between the northern expeditionary force of the **Maratha Empire** and the invading forces of **Ahmad Shah Abdali**, the King of Afghanistan.
 
• **Abdali was supported by** two Indian allies—**the Rohillas of the Doab region and Shuja-ud-Daula, the Nawab of Awadh.**
 
• The battle is often considered** the beginning of the end of the Mughal Empire and the start of British ascendency** despite them not being part of the conflict.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dost Mohammad**: Dost Mohammad Khan was the founder of the Barakzai dynasty and one of the prominent rulers of Afghanistan during the First Anglo-Afghan War.
 
• **Nadir Shah**: Nadir Shah was a ruler from Persia (Iran) who invaded India in 1739.
 
• **Babur**: Babur was the **founder of the Mughal Empire** and the first Emperor of the Mughal dynasty in the Indian subcontinent. He was involved in the **First Battle of Panipat in 1526**.
